response.original_title: 恥辱の抵当妻 夫のミスに付け込んだ輩達…失敗の穴埋め抵当として若妻は、無償労働に就かされる…。
response.overview: Koichi and Alice have been married for two years. However, Koichi's company is struggling due to the recent economic downturn. One day, Koichi is reprimanded by Kita, an employee of one of his clients, for damages caused by Koichi's mistakes. Given the company's situation, Koichi cannot possibly consult his superiors, so he accepts Kita's offer to have Alice work for his company. However, this is the beginning of a despicable trap cleverly devised by Kita...
response.title: The Humiliated Mortgage Wife: Those who took advantage of her husband's mistakes... The young wife is forced into unpaid labor as collateral to cover the losses from his failure...
